title: REPORT on the implementation of the Council Recommendation of 30 October 2020 on A Bridge to Jobs – Reinforcing the Youth Guarantee and replacing the Council Recommendation of 22 April 2013 on establishing a Youth Guarantee
part_text: Calls for the development of gradual reintegration pathways for young people with fewer opportunities as explicit intermediate outcomes within the RYG, to help them acquire soft skills, work habits, confidence and recognised learning outcomes before transitioning into formal education, training or quality employment; stresses the need for the inclusion in such pathways of structured volunteering, civic engagement and participation opportunities, youth work, sports, social enterprises and community placements, tailored to individual needs and linked to follow-up pathways;
